This is a vulnerability that started from a compromised Claude code extension. Attackers use that to get access to your GitHub's personal access token. Then they push malicious obsfucated code to your repo.

Update your Claude code extension to the latest, revoke your PAT. https://t.co/36PmTE6tAF

text:
👀 Claude Code before 2.1.325 could run some Bash commands without a permission prompt, and its sandbox had gaps.

If you run Claude Code on dev machines, CI or self-hosted runners, update to 2.1.325. Until then, Bash allow/deny rules and the sandbox may not stop untrusted repos https://t.co/F82Agu8uI4
